chapter: Entertainers, Creole Serenaders and La Vida
title: La Vida band lineup with Kid Howard and Jim Robinson
summary: Turner names the musicians in the La Vida band, with its banjo and guitar players.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Oh, La Vida? Yeah, I was there with Kit Howard, Jim Robinson, Paul Bones, Davis on drums, Paul Bones on saxophone, I was on piano, Jim Robinson on tramboy, and Kit Howard.
Sidney Fleury, I think, was banded with the guitar.
And before, when something went wrong with the machine, you told about the guy that got killed playing banjo.
Uh, Gahir, eh? They had two different guys? Yeah, they had two different guys. Yeah, so he got killed quite naturally in Sidney, and he knew he took his place. Yeah.
They had a lot of guys that played there. I know Danny Barker used to be there, and John L. Jones, a different town.
